description: Clicks and QR scans for one of the user's own Snip links: totals, by day, by hour of the day on plans with time-of-day analytics, and the top countries, referring sites and devices. Needs the user signed in to Snip (the account endpoint or an API key). Pass the short link, its ending or its id. For every link at once, use get_account_stats.

days.description: How many days back, up to the plan's limit (30 on Free, a year on Pro). Default 30.

link.description: The short link (https://snip.link/abc123), its ending (abc123) or its id.

name: get_link_stats
title: Get link stats
